mac_research_executor.note: Mac research export of the selected DA3 CoreML model; phone thermal/RSS is not part of this benchmark.

windowing_policy.officialStreamingDefault: ordered image chunks with half-chunk overlap; no AR/VIO pose graph input
windowing_policy.runtimePadding: only for fixed-N CoreML runtimes; officialChunkFrameIDs preserves unpadded PyTorch chunk semantics
windowing_policy.downstreamRule: Dart consumes only officialSaveFrameIDs, matching results_output/frame_*.npz core downstream instead of full-chunk merge
windowing_policy.geometryContinuityAudit: diagnostic only; does not use AR/VIO to select official chunks or feed official image-only DA3
windowing_policy.officialReplicationBoundary: Research-only product adaptation candidate. Official source window is preserved in sourceCaptureDir; these windows keep DA3 N35 runtime shape but alter which real frames are fed before padding.

loop_closure_policy.symmetryGuard: loop edges are optional add-ons; official sequential chunks remain image-order chunks, not AR/VIO pose graph patches

official_postprocess.algorithm: official DA3 Umeyama pose_scale + input intrinsics/extrinsics refill
